label: Canadian public pension
field.name: Name
field.earningsMonthly: Gross CPP or QPP per month
field.oasYears: Complete years of Canadian residence after age 18
field.gisThrough: Last month covered by the GIS quote (YYYY-MM)
help.earnings: Use your age-65 estimate from Service Canada or Retraite Québec. If payments have started, enter your current gross monthly amount.
help.qppEarlyRate: Use your applicable rate between 0.5% and 0.6%. The default is the maximum reduction.
help.oasYears: Use complete years at approval. Enter 0 to omit OAS. Standard residence rules require at least 10 years in Canada or 20 years when living abroad.
help.oasMonthly: Use the full rate for ages 65–74 before adjustments. If payments have started, enter your current gross payment before any recovery withholding.
help.gis: Enter a confirmed GIS amount covering the period from OAS start or plan start through the last month in the quote.
summary.claim: Separate CPP/QPP and OAS start dates
invalid.owner: Choose an individual with a birth year and month.
invalid.name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
invalid.earnings: Enter a nonnegative CPP or QPP amount.
invalid.qppRate: Enter a QPP reduction rate between 0.5% and 0.6% per month.
invalid.oas: Enter a nonnegative OAS amount and either 0 or 10–40 complete years of residence.
invalid.gis: A positive GIS quote requires OAS and a last month in YYYY-MM format.
invalid.earningsStart: Choose a valid CPP or QPP start.
invalid.duplicate: Keep one Canadian public pension per recipient.
field.oasFirstPayment: First month eligible for OAS, if after 65
field.oasFullPayment: First month eligible for full OAS
help.oasFirstPayment: Leave blank if first eligible in the month after your 65th birthday.
help.oasQualifyingYears: Enter 0 if the number of complete years stays the same through approval.
invalid.oasQualification: Enter a valid first eligibility month and eligible residence years at that date.
invalid.oasFullQualification: Enter a full-rate eligibility month on or after the first eligible month.
